summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests the safety, side effects, and best dose of AOH1996, a PCNA inhibitor, given with azacitidine and venetoclax, in adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML). AOH1996 is taken by mouth twice a day on days 1 to 28 of each 28-day cycle, and patients receive up to 2 cycles, or up to 12 if they reach complete remission with transfusion independence and the disease does not progress. The schedule for azacitidine and venetoclax is not stated. No main outcome measure is stated in the record; the study is a Phase 1 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la dosis más adecuada de AOH1996, un inhibidor de PCNA, administrado junto con azacitidina y venetoclax, en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda (LMA) recidivante o refractaria. AOH1996 se toma por vía oral dos veces al día los días 1 a 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y los pacientes reciben hasta 2 ciclos, o hasta 12 si logran una remisión completa con independencia de transfusiones y la enfermedad no progresa. El esquema de azacitidina y venetoclax no se indica. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de Fase 1.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory AML that failed available effective treatment, or for which such treatment is not an option.
ECOG performance status of 2 or less and life expectancy over 3 months.
White blood cell count of 25 x 10^9/L or less before starting study therapy.
Adequate liver, kidney, and blood clotting test results within 14 days before day 1.
not_for: Acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) or t(15;17) abnormality.
Hematopoietic stem cell transplant within 100 days before day 1.
Active central nervous system disease or active graft versus host disease.
Unstable heart disease, including heart attack within the past 6 months.
